import re

def first_label(line):
    match = re.search(r'\[(.*)\]', line)
    return match.group(1) if match else None
files.tests/test_behavior.py:
import unittest
import build_labels as app

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_first_pair(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.first_label('[build] compiling [cache]'), 'build')
        self.assertEqual(app.first_label('prefix [one][two][three]'), 'one')
        self.assertEqual(app.first_label('[ slow job ] ready'), ' slow job ')
        self.assertEqual(app.first_label('[] [later]'), '')
    def test_absent_and_single(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.first_label('job [worker-7] ready'), 'worker-7')
        self.assertIsNone(app.first_label('no label'))
        self.assertIsNone(app.first_label('[unfinished'))
        self.assertIsNone(app.first_label(''))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
